title: Add On-Balance Volume (OBV) and Accumulation/Distribution (A/D)
description: Two volume-based indicators from Elder ch. 29, missing entirely (grep confirms). OBV: running total, add the day's volume if close > prior close, subtract if close < prior close, unchanged if flat. A/D: `(Close - Open) / (High - Low) * Volume`, cumulative running total -- more finely calibrated than OBV since it credits volume proportional to where the close landed within the day's range, not the whole day's volume to whichever side 'won'. Both are cumulative series whose absolute level is meaningless (depends on start date) -- only their pattern of highs/lows and divergence against price matters, same as every other oscillator in this app. This task is computation + exposure only -- divergence detection against these two (also mentioned in docs/ideas.md) depends on backend-swing-point-detector and is out of scope here.

checklist.step: Implement obv() and accumulation_distribution() in backend/app/indicators/, following existing module conventions.
Hand-computed reference-value tests for both (small OHLCV series, values worked out by hand).

Expose both as new cumulative series in the indicator-history endpoint (they're not meaningful as a single latest-bar value the way oscillators like Stochastic are -- decide the response shape and record as a decisions entry).
Regenerate backend/openapi.json and frontend/src/api/types.ts; document in docs/Analyse.md.

decisions.decision: Expose obv/accumulation_distribution only as new required (never-null) fields on IndicatorHistoryPoint (GET /api/stocks/{ticker}/indicators), computed once directly from the full daily_ohlcv in app/api/routers/stocks.py rather than threaded through app.signals.engine.analyse/analyse_history's indicators dict. NOT added to AnalysisResponse.indicators (the /analysis latest-bar snapshot).
decisions.rationale: The task's own checklist already narrows this to the indicator-history endpoint specifically, since a cumulative series' absolute level is meaningless in isolation without the trailing history to compare it against -- unlike rsi/season (also computation+exposure-only additions), which are meaningful single-bar values and so are exposed on both endpoints. Computing them directly in the router (rather than adding obv/ad passthrough parameters to analyse()/analyse_history()) was chosen because they need no Screen/Impulse/confidence context and no per-bar truncation for correctness: both are purely causal cumulative sums over daily_ohlcv (a value at bar t depends only on data up to and including t), so a single computation over the full series can be sliced by position exactly like the precomputed EMA/MACD/Stochastic series already are, without adding two more parameters to analyse()'s already-large signature or duplicating the recompute in the /analysis route. Rejected: adding obv/ad to the Indicators schema too (rejected per the checklist's own framing of a latest-bar value being meaningless here) and threading them through analyse()/analyse_history() as passthrough parameters (rejected as unnecessary complexity/signature growth for a computation that needs none of that machinery -- SignalResult/analyse() stays scoped to Screen-dependent indicators).

decisions.decision: OBV's undefined first-bar direction (no prior close to compare against) is mapped to a 0 contribution (np.sign(close.diff()).fillna(0.0)), not to the alternative convention of seeding the running total with the first bar's own raw volume. Similarly, A/D's zero-range bars (high == low, making close-open)/(high-low) a 0/0 division) are mapped to a 0 contribution via .where(range != 0, other=0.0), not left as NaN.
decisions.rationale: Both series are cumulative (pd.Series.cumsum()), and NaN is 'sticky' under cumsum -- a single undefined day would otherwise poison every later cumulative total for the rest of the series, unlike a non-cumulative oscillator (e.g. app.indicators.stochastic.stochastic_oscillator, which safely leaves a zero-range bar's %K as NaN via plain division, since that NaN only affects that one bar). 0 was chosen over volume[0]-as-seed for OBV because the app's own framing ('only the pattern of highs/lows and divergence matters, absolute level is meaningless') makes the starting anchor arbitrary either way, and 0 is the more literal reading of 'add/subtract volume based on direction, with an undefined first direction contributing nothing' rather than implicitly asserting the first bar's own volume was itself bullish. Rejected: leaving these NaN (breaks every subsequent cumulative value, unlike every other indicator's warm-up-then-clean pattern in this app) and seeding OBV[0]=volume[0] (an equally arbitrary, but less literal, convention).

comments.summary: Making obv/accumulation_distribution required (non-nullable) fields on IndicatorHistoryPoint breaks the frontend build: `yarn tsc -b --noEmit` fails with 6 TS2739 errors ('missing the following properties ... accumulation_distribution, obv') because three pre-existing test files construct IndicatorHistoryPoint-shaped literals without the two new fields. frontend/tests/mocks/handlers.ts's shared fixture was correctly updated, but these three files build their own separate local fixtures that were missed. vitest itself still passes (it doesn't type-check), so this was only caught by running tsc directly, not by the test suite. Blocking: static analysis is a hard gate per CLAUDE.md/pr-reviewer's process.
Same missing-fields TS2739 error as OscillatorChart.test.tsx:132/147/180, at two more literal sites.
Same missing-fields TS2739 error as above, one more site.

review.notes: Everything else checks out: backend suite 759 passed/99.92% coverage, frontend suite 536 passed/99%+ coverage (no regression, both well above the 90% gate); backend ruff+mypy clean; frontend eslint clean. code-review skill (independent background pass) converged on the exact same single finding and raised nothing else. Hand-verified the obv and accumulation_distribution reference-value fixtures independently (recomputed both by hand from the fixture inputs, matched the committed pytest.approx assertions exactly) -- both formulas match Elder ch. 29's standard OBV/A-D definitions. Confirmed via grep across backend/app/ that obv/accumulation_distribution are referenced nowhere outside app/indicators/{obv,accumulation_distribution}.py, app/api/schemas.py, and app/api/routers/stocks.py -- genuinely never read by _determine_signal, confidence.py, or analyse()/analyse_history()'s screens, matching the task's own decisions entry and docs/Analyse.md's new §4 rows. The two edge-case decisions (OBV's undefined first-bar direction and A/D's zero-range-bar division both mapped to a 0 contribution instead of NaN, to avoid NaN poisoning the cumsum) are reasonable and correctly implemented -- verified against both indicator modules' code and their dedicated unit tests (test_first_bar_is_not_nan, test_zero_range_bar_contributes_zero_not_nan). backend/openapi.json regenerated and matches frontend/src/api/types.ts (re-ran scripts/export_openapi.py from a clean checkout -- zero diff); both have the new required obv/accumulation_distribution fields with schema descriptions per CLAUDE.md's API documentation standard. No new module/dependency/layer added (architecture-review not triggered); no frontend component added or changed (only frontend/src/api/types.ts and frontend/tests/mocks/handlers.ts touched), so the components/common/-vs-feature placement check (step 7a) doesn't apply. Browser walkthrough performed against the stock detail page (GET /api/stocks/{ticker}/indicators already has frontend consumers -- OscillatorChart/PriceChart): golden path (AAPL, 1Y range) renders the full analysis panel, price chart, and oscillator panels correctly with obv/accumulation_distribution present in the API response, zero console/network errors; edge case (unknown ticker ZZZZZZ) shows the expected 404/not-found handling, only the expected 404 network entries. Also ran the persisted e2e suite (make e2e): all 16 specs across 5 files passed, including stock-analysis.spec.ts's 1Y/max-range and unknown-ticker specs which exercise this same endpoint. Noted in passing: GET /api/stocks/{ticker}/indicators?range=1y took ~42s against the live yfinance provider in this dev environment; confirmed via a direct curl comparison that this is pre-existing live-network latency in my local walkthrough setup (not caused by this PR's O(1) vectorized obv/ad cumsum additions, and not reproducible at all against the fixture provider, where the same request is fast) -- not filed as a follow-up since it isn't this PR's issue and the underlying analyse_history performance question is already tracked and resolved by the api-stocks-indicator-history-followups task chain. No checklist item phrased as 'decide X' was left undecided -- the response-shape decision and the two edge-case-mapping decisions are both recorded with rationale and rejected alternatives, meeting CLAUDE.md's decision-memory bar. No non-blocking findings beyond the one blocking tsc issue above, so no <id>-followups task was created this round.
